full_details: At two you played. The tale is the same tale. At the reckoning the gallery was not all in. Heminges left Monday's eleven pound eight where it was and struck no new share. You did not count the coffer. Edith's eight shillings stayed a promise till Lady Day. The Rose's bill is Tasso. You did not go. After that you walked up to the Jackdaw with Burbage. Buttered eggs and ling. You read the last act as far as it goes: the Worthies, the messenger, the ladies' sentence of a year. The half-line is still empty. He was silent a full minute. Then he said he does not get her. You said not for a twelvemonth and a day. He said that is too long for a play. You wrote it down, and it is Berowne's now. You did not strike it. Agnes said dinner is sixpence, wit is extra, and that was the first time she saw a player pay for a line. You did not give him a part, a song, or a last line. On the walk home you sneezed twice. The latch sprang when you lifted it softly. You are not ill.
one_sentence: You played Egeon and read Burbage the act at the Jackdaw.
title: Played Egeon and read Burbage the act
